title: Agents (M14)
brief: Agents screen of goop (/agents), the full version of the sidebar Agents tree (enter there opens it). Title breadcrumb (Agents › jobs and subagents · 1 running · 3 finished · esc back to session 3); no key-hint line under the header. Two panes like lazydocker: on the left a tree of runs (claude agents / agent-monitor), Running pinned on top and expanded (◐ Daily search · 09:00 · 4m 12s with ├ └ children ✓ Explorer 1,240 companies 2m 40s, ◐ Reranker ranking 100 0m 31s selected, ○ Security waiting for ranking, ○ Analytic waiting), then Finished runs folded and newest first (✓ search_offers · from chat 10:42 · 0.3s, ✓ Daily search · yesterday 09:00 · 9 new offers · 6m 02s, ⚠ Daily search · Oct 30 · failed at Lever · 3m 10s in pink); branches --border, state colors per system, durations right-aligned muted. On the right the selected subagent (Reranker · step 2 of 4) with tabs Progress · Log 48 · Output 34: what it does, a mini meter ranking 34 / 100, model and device (Qwen3-Reranker · CPU · ~1.1 offers/s), elapsed and ETA, in 312 offers → out 100, the sequential next step (Security reads the ranked 100 after Reranker finishes; then Analytic), and a live log tail as dim plain text behind a │ gutter. One status line with the agents focus mode, hints ↑↓ move · ←→ fold · [ ] tabs · c cancel run · r rerun · esc back and ◐ 1 running │ ? help. Below the screen: the empty state (No jobs running · next search 09:00 · r run now), the one-line y/n cancel ask with a --primary edge that says Explorer's results are kept, and the failed Oct 30 run unfolded (Explorer stopped at Lever on HTTP 429, the rest not run) with its retry history.

artboards.title: Full screen
artboards.tradeoff: A runs tree with the live run pinned on top next to one tabbed detail of the selected subagent; progress, timing and the pipeline are visible at a glance and finished runs stay one fold away, but only one subagent and one tab show at a time, the Running and Finished headers cost two rows and the screen hides the chat
